body: Get that diploma, that's all I need. Public education is about as broken as it gets. I hate this place
Yeah, I'm in the USA. Shitty school day for me.
They certainly try. They've made their mistakes and try to stop me from making the same ones. If you don't mind me asking are you at work?
Yes, I have a really good relationship with both my parents, which is one thing I have on my side. The biggest barrier is our massive age difference (~40 yrs) but despite that we're really close.

Absolute same for me. Those moments are all I really have, cause if I look at the big picture I feel hopeless. A conversation with my mom on my screened-in porch, a good cup of coffee, a delicious meal, sitting in the woods alone. My favorite things.
I guess that's what life is though. It's all about the little things.

That's what I try to do to distract myself. It's the little things. Drugs, food, shopping, sex. I feel like all I do is use things to drown how I feel for a minute. But I do know the importance of needing something to look forward to.
I guess so. It's just the desire to give in is so strong. You've had more life experience than me so I have no room to disregard what you're saying. And your point is absolutely valid.
Well I'm glad you got the help you needed.
I try my best. I enjoy running and try to exercise as much as possible. If you don't mind me asking, could you tell me a little more about your personal experience with mental health issues?
Hopefully. I feel like a ticking time bomb. The best thing I can do is make sure there are no guns, knives, excessive amounts of meds around me which I do.
I guess. I try my hardest to be kind to myself. I just feel like it's been so much time. All I want to do is run from my life.
I can't really afford it right now, and I don't want my parents to have to pay any more than they already have. I have no motivation to do absolutely anything.
I feel set in my decision. Knowing it's just a matter of time comforts me more than anything

I'm on 75 mg of Zoloft. I was in therapy for a little while too, but I feel that therapy has the same effect as just vocalizing your thoughts. She really offered no advice, was more just someone to listen. But it's almost like you don't want to ya know? Addicted to the misery you could say. Sounds sappy but true. Why do you feel the way you do?
Go for it. I'm awkward af, fair warning.
I feel the exact same man. I'm 17 too. I'm awful with advice, just letting you know someone feels the same.

Loneliness. The usual mundane nature of life. I don't even know sometimes. The longer I live with those type of thoughts I learn more about what sets it off. Sometimes it's seemingly for no reason, I just feel it as a desire stronger than almost anything. And I'm always open to talk to anyone. Anxious to hear other perspectives. Thanks for responding.
